title: Felix and the Gravity
author: Casper Villalobos
blurb: Mara Dravenmoor, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
